items.title: Exit polls show pro-Ukraine United List party leading Latvian parliamentary elections as counting begins
items.teaser: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs’ centrist United List party is projected to win the greatest number of seats in the Latvian parliament with 35% support, exit polling commissioned by public broadcaster LSM showed on Oct. 3.

items.title: Ukraine’s bomber drones, ones that dropped ground robots in its recent Donetsk counteroffensive, are getting 2.4-kilogram jammer to shield them from FPVs
items.teaser: Aura-Ukraine is final-testing Aura 3K mini, a compact electronic-warfare shield.

items.title: Anschlag in England geplant - Terrorverdächtiger lebte fünf Jahre in Deutschland
items.teaser: Iraner soll jüdische Ziele in Manchester geplant haben, zuvor lebte er in Deutschland.

items.title: A Nobel laureate’s deal: free Russia’s prisoners, fund the missiles hitting Ukraine
items.teaser: The laureate is Dmitry Muratov, and the deal he urged on Washington would lift sanctions on Russia's war economy in exchange for releasing the very dissidents the Kremlin jailed.

items.title: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, October 3, 2026
items.teaser: Toplines Five Russian drones, including Banderol loitering munitions, crashed in Moldova on the morning of October 3, exceeding the number of aerial vehicles involved in the…

items.title: Russian strike on Liberian-flagged cargo ship in Black Sea kills 1, injures 3
items.teaser: The attack comes amid an international call for Russia to halt attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea and allow the passage of grain exports.

items.title: Pontonbrücken und Tunnel unter dem Dnipro – russische Angriffe zwingen Kyjiw, nach alternativen Lösungen zu suchen
items.teaser: Ab nächster Woche soll in Kyjiw mit dem Bau mehrerer Pontonbrücken über den Fluss Dniprobegonnen werden. Die könnten als Alternative im Falle von Beschädigung der bestehenden Übergänge genutzt werden. In langfristiger Perspektive werde auch die Möglichkeit von Bau eines Tunnels unter dem Fluss geprüft.

items.title: As Russia expands attacks on Kyiv, Ukraine prepares to hit Moscow’s oil industry harder in response
items.teaser: Ukraine plans to intensify strikes on Russian refineries while racing to develop new interceptor drones, missiles, and other weapons ahead of another winter campaign.

items.title: Moscow unveils 'new doctrine' targeting Ukrainian civilians, Zelensky vows to respond with more energy strikes
items.teaser: Zelensky said that Ukrainian intelligence obtained documents revealing that Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a "new doctrine" allowing Russian forces to launch broader strikes against Ukrainian civilian targets this upcoming winter.

items.title: Sie feiern das Hamas-Massaker - Berliner Gruppe plant nächste Terror-Demo zum 7. Oktober
items.teaser: Berlin – Der grausame 7. Oktober 2023: Das Hamas-Massaker im Süden Israels war noch in vollem Gange, da brach auf Berlins Straßen sc...

items.title: Terrorverdacht erhärtet sich nach Vorfall in "Fyldubai"-Maschine auf dem Weg nach Tel Aviv
items.teaser: Terrorverdacht erhärtet sich nach Vorfall in "Fyldubai"-Maschine auf dem Weg nach Tel Aviv

items.title: Up to 140 sq km already liberated in Operation Vivaldi, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that up to 140 square kilometres have been liberated during the Operation Vivaldi counteroffensive and Russian casualties have increased significantly.

items.title: Ukraine to step up strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to Putin's 'new doctrine' – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine will step up strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to Russia's new tactics of launching massive attacks on civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Zelenskyy: US must not forget it is a hundred times stronger than Russia in negotiations
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged the US not to forget its strength in negotiations with Russia, noting that Vladimir Putin has begun to believe he is the one who decides.

items.title: Selenskyj: unsere Sanktionen haben Gebiet Samara und Stützpunkte für Iskander-Raketen im Gebiet Brjansk erreicht
items.teaser: Ukrainische Sanktionen haben heute die russische Region Samara sowie Stellungen russischer Besatzer in der Region Brjansk, von denen sie Iskander -Raketen abfeuern, erreicht.

items.title: Three injured as Russian forces shell Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times with various types of weapons on October 3, injuring three civilians.

items.title: Zelenskyy: FP-9 ballistic missile capable of reaching Moscow will be ready this autumn
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that the Ukrainian FP-9 ballistic missile, which has a range that reaches Moscow, will be ready for use this autumn.

items.title: Ukraine to step up oil attacks as Russia hits Kyiv bridges
items.teaser: As Moscow intensifies attacks on Kyiv and other cities, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has vowed to hit Russian energy infrastructure.

items.title: Kyiv to start building pontoon bridges over Dnipro – Kalashnyk
items.teaser: Kyiv plans to begin construction of several backup crossings over the Dnipro River next week that could be used if bridges are damaged. In the longer term, authorities are also considering building a tunnel under the river.

items.title: Ukraine’s top general wants to end Soviet rules in army. But president’s wartime headquarters may still hold biggest one, commander says
items.teaser: Mykhailo Drapatyi is held responsible for the army but cannot freely appoint his own command team.

items.title: Ukraine will step up strikes on Russian refineries in response to Moscow's aerial terror, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine will intensify its strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to Moscow's new campaign of airstrikes aimed at forcing people to flee Kyiv and other cities.

items.title: Russische Drohne stürzt auf Fahrbahn in Hajworon ab: es gibt einen Toten und eine Verletzte
items.teaser: Durch den Absturz einer russischen Drohne auf die Fahrbahn in der Stadt Hajworon im Gebiet Kirowograd ist ein Mann getötet worden. Eine Frau wurde verletzt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Andrij Rajkowitsch, auf Telegram, mit.

items.title: Pontoon crossings coming to Kyiv following Russian strikes on key bridges, media reports
items.teaser: A Ukrainian official said that the construction of pontoon crossings could take up to three months and would help traffic move through the capital, which remains heavily restricted after multiple bridge attacks.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine's sanctions now reach Samara region and Iskander launch sites in Bryansk region
items.teaser: Ukrainian sanctions today reached the Samara region and the positions of Russian invaders manning Iskander launchers in the Bryansk region of the Russian Federation.

items.title: Chișinău summons Russian ambassador over entry of missiles and drones into Moldova
items.teaser: Moldova's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has summoned Russian Ambassador Oleg Ozerov following the unauthorised flight of drones and missiles over its airspace.

items.title: “No alien quantum modems”: 1 to 3 concealed devices in Kyiv may be why Russian drones keep hitting so precisely, Ukraine’s top tech adviser says
items.teaser: MESH transmitters may give Russia a real-time channel to steer jet drones onto Kyiv's bridges.

items.title: Drone debris falls onto roof of high-rise building in Kyiv's Obolon district
items.teaser: In Kyiv’s Obolon district, debris from a drone fell onto the roof of a high-rise building, causing a fire.

items.title: Russisches Militär greift zivile Unternehmen in Sumy mit Gleitbomben an
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben zivile Unternehmen im Kowpakowskyj Bezirk der Stadt Sumy mit vier Gleitbomben angegriffen. Einschläge wurden an zwei Orten registriert.

items.title: Drone crashes on road in Kirovohrad Oblast: man killed, woman injured
items.teaser: A man has been killed and a woman injured as a result of a UAV falling on a road in the town of Haivoron, Kirovohrad Oblast, on 3 October.

items.title: Ukraine’s $33 veterans’ gym subsidy drew 800,000 uses. Now it is gone, squeezed by war and stalled reforms, holding up $20 billion in aid
items.teaser: The Veteran Sports program stopped on 1 October after the state found no money for it.

items.title: Drone crashes onto roadway in Haivoron, killing one person and injuring another
items.teaser: In the city of Haivoron, Kirovohrad region, a man was killed and a woman was injured when a Russian drone crashed onto the roadway.

items.title: Ukraine has hit targets in Russia's Samara and Bryansk oblasts, Zelenskyy says – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine struck targets in Russia's Samara and Bryansk oblasts over the past 24 hours, and there are also results in the Black Sea.

items.title: Video zeigt Flucht aus dem russisch besetzten Oleschky
items.teaser: Der Beauftragte der Werchowna Rada für Menschenrechte, Dmytro Lubinets, hat auf Facebook ein Video veröffentlicht, welches zeigt, wie Dutzende Menschen versuchen, aus der von Russland besetzten Stadt Oleschky in der Region Cherson zu fliehen.

items.title: Disabled Ukrainian woman abducted by Russians from Oleshky care home goes missing in Russia
items.teaser: Relatives and acquaintances have lost contact with Anastasiia Mamotiuk, a disabled Ukrainian woman who is in Russia after being abducted from the Oleshky care home.

items.title: Kyiv authorities retract report of drone debris falling on apartment block
items.teaser: Kyiv authorities have refuted earlier reports that debris from a Russian UAV caused a fire on the roof of a 16-storey residential building in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district on the evening of 3 October.

items.title: Ukraine to set up working group to identify fallen soldiers
items.teaser: Ukraine's National Security and Defence Council will establish a working body to consider issues related to the identification of fallen military personnel.

items.title: Writer: Netherlands still struggles to shake off narrative of Russia as Ukraine's “big brother”
items.teaser: Lisa Weeda, a Dutch writer of Ukrainian descent, stated that in the Netherlands it is still difficult to shake off the narrative of Russia as Ukraine’s “big brother.”

items.title: Kyiv is preparing pontoon crossings in case of bridge strikes and planning tunnel under Dnipro River – minister
items.teaser: Ukraine's Recovery Minister Mykola Kalashnyk has announced plans to build reserve pontoon crossings and potentially a tunnel under the Dnipro River in Kyiv.

items.title: Moldova reports sixth unauthorised flight in airspace amid Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova's Ministry of Defence has reported a sixth unauthorised flight in the country's airspace amid a massive morning Russian attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Russian-to-Ukrainian force ratio is 6:1 in some areas – Ukrainian National Guard commander
items.teaser: Oleksandr Pivnenko, Commander of the National Guard of Ukraine, has reiterated that the ratio of advancing Russian forces to Ukrainian troops is 6 to 1 in some frontline areas in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Donnyland abandoned: the last negotiations of the year
Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges could create "logistical nightmare" for Ukraine, NYT reports
items.teaser: Russian attacks could force the authorities to close Kyiv's bridges for an extended period, which would create a logistical nightmare for the capital and Ukraine, The New York Times reports.

items.title: Russische Drohnen schlagen in Moldau ein: Explosionen waren in mehreren Gebieten zu hören
items.teaser: Das nationale Luftraumüberwachungssystem Moldaus hat am Samstagmorgen den Überflug mehrerer Drohnen registriert, wie das Nachrichtenportal Newsmaker berichtet.

items.title: Russian guided bomb strikes hit businesses in Sumy region
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked civilian enterprises in the Kovpakivsky District of Sumy with four guided bombs; hits were recorded at two locations.

items.title: Ukraine receives €50m from Council of Europe bank and Italy for destroyed housing compensation
items.teaser: Ukraine has received €50 million under the Council of Europe Development Bank project to finance housing certificates under the eRecovery state programme.

items.title: Series of drone attacks disrupt power supply near Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant, IAEA says
items.teaser: The strikes damaged transformers considered vital for maintaining the ZNPP’s off-site power supply.

items.title: Transformatoren nahe des AKW Saporischschja beschädigt: IAEA verhandelt über lokale Waffenruhe
items.teaser: Die Internationale Atomenergieagentur (IAEO) berichtet über eine Serie von Drohnenangriffen in den letzten Wochen, welche eine wachsende Bedrohung für Reaktorsicherheit und Strahlenschutz am Kernkraftwerk Saporischschja darstellen.

items.title: Lubinets shows dozens of people trying to leave Oleshky
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, the Verkhovna Rada Commissioner for Human Rights, posted a video showing dozens of people in Oleshky, Kherson region—which is currently occupied by Russian forces—trying to leave the city on their own.

items.title: Grandmother and granddaughter killed by Russia in Kyiv home where three generations grew up
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike on a house in Kyiv on 30 September killed 45-year-old Yevheniia and her 94-year-old grandmother Mariia.

items.title: Ukraine fired its first FP-7 ballistic missile in combat. Its maker says next version will do what Ukraine needed since 2022
items.teaser: Zelensky announced the launch on 1 October without naming the target, and wrote that production comes next.

items.title: Russia strikes second major Kyiv bridge in two days as attacks disrupt movement across the capital
items.teaser: A Russian drone damaged Kyiv’s Northern Bridge, injuring two people, one day after repeated strikes on the Southern Bridge caused major traffic disruption.

items.title: Putin claims Russia seized 1,301 square kilometers of Ukrainian territory in September, sharply diverging from ISW data
items.teaser: Kremlin dictator Vladimir Putin claimed that in September, Russian troops seized more than 1,300 km² of Ukrainian territory; however, these claims differ significantly from the actual data on the situation at the front.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Zelenskyy says he has asked Trump to sanction Russian and Chinese companies developing Starlink rival
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called on his US counterpart Donald Trump to impose sanctions on Russian and Chinese companies involved in developing the Rassvet satellite network, a potential competitor to Elon Musk's Starlink.

items.title: US and Russia are negotiating multibillion-dollar deal on Lukoil assets, says NYT
items.teaser: The US presidential administration's talks with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine have expanded to include a multibillion-dollar oil deal involving Lukoil assets.

items.title: Sicherheit - Mutmaßliche Anschlagspläne: zwei Verdächtige wieder frei
items.teaser: Zwei der drei Männer, die in Hagen und Unna wegen mutmaßlicher Anschlagspläne festgenommen wurden, sind wieder auf freiem Fuß.

items.title: Angriff auf Passagiermaschine - Arabische Ermittler sprechen von Terroranschlag - Co-Pilot galt offenbar als Sicherheitsrisiko
items.teaser: Der Angriff im Cockpit einer Passagiermaschine auf dem Weg nach Israel war nach Einschätzung der Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate ein versuchter Terroranschlag. Der Co-Pilot galt Medienberichten zufolge als Sicherheitsrisiko.

items.title: Russian forces attack civilian vessel in Odesa region port, killing one and injuring three others
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked a civilian cargo ship flying the Liberian flag in one of the ports of the Odesa region; one crew member was killed and three were wounded.

items.title: Russen greifen ziviles Schiff im Hafen von Odessa an: es gibt einen Toten und drei Verletzte
items.teaser: Das russische Militär hat ein unter der Flagge Liberas fahrendes ziviles Frachtschiff in einem der Häfen der Region Odessa angegriffen. Ein Besatzungsmitglied wurde getötet und drei weitere verletzt, teilt die Verwaltung der Seehäfen der Ukraine auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Ukraine tests EW system to protect heavy bomber drones and ground robots
items.teaser: Ukrainian defence company Aura-Ukraine has begun final tests of an electronic warfare (EW) system called Aura 3K mini, designed to protect heavy bomber drones and uncrewed ground vehicles.

items.title: Geiselhaft: Und dann hörte Moses im Radio, dass seine Frau tot ist
items.teaser: Am 7. Oktober 2023 überfielen Terroristen aus dem Gazastreifen Grenzorte in Israel, töteten und entführten viele Menschen, darunter auch Deutsche. Wie geht es den ehemaligen Geiseln heute?

items.title: Russland beschießt erneut Brücke in Kiew
items.teaser: Erneut hat Russland eine Brücke in der ukrainischen Hauptstadt beschossen - diesmal traf es die Nordbrücke. Bereits am Vortag waren drei von sechs Straßenbrücken Kiews angegriffen und beschädigt worden.

items.title: Three Russian missiles and two drones strike Moldovan territory in morning attacks on neighboring Ukraine. Moldova is increasingly exposed to the risks of Russia’s war next door
items.teaser: Russia’s intensified attacks on Ukraine are creating growing risks for Moldova, with Russian weapons increasingly crossing into its territory.

items.title: Zwei Verletzte bei russischem Angriff auf Nordbrücke in Kyjiw
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff auf die Nordbrücke in Kyjiw sind zwei Menschen verletzt worden.

items.title: IAEA reports damage to transformers near Zaporizhzhia NPP, seeks truce for repairs
items.teaser: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has reported a series of drone attacks in recent weeks that have further heightened the threat to nuclear safety and security at the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP).

items.title: Region Sumy binnen eines Tages massiv angegriffen, drei Todesopfer
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden, am 2. Oktober haben die russischen Truppen 80 Mal das Gebiet der Region Sumy angegriffen.

items.title: Two people injured in Russian morning strike on Pivnichnyi bridge in Kyiv
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian strike on the Pivnichnyi (North) Bridge in Kyiv on the morning of Saturday 3 October.

items.title: Lubinets urges Kazakhstan to prevent extradition of Ukrainian citizen to Russia
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Parliament's Human Rights Commissioner, Dmytro Lubinets, has urged Kazakhstan's Ombudsman Artur Lastayev to prevent the extradition to Russia of a Ukrainian woman who was lured to Astana by Russian special services and her grandson's new family.

items.title: Five drones enter Moldovan airspace, leaving wreckage and damage – photos
items.teaser: Five drones crossed Moldova’s airspace during a large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine, with wreckage found in several locations and property damaged.

items.title: Anklage gegen Iraner: Terrorplan gegen jüdische Gemeinde?
items.teaser: Zwei Männer sollen im nordenglischen Manchester Anschläge auf die jüdische Gemeinde vorbereitet haben.

items.title: Two injured in Russian strike on Northern Bridge in Kyiv
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian strike on the Northern Bridge in Kyiv on Saturday.

items.title: Russians attack civilian ship at Odesa Oblast port, killing sailor
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a Liberian-flagged civilian cargo ship at a port in Odesa Oblast, killing one sailor and injuring three other crew members.

items.title: Forpost Brigade regains control of over 10 sq km in its area of responsibility
items.teaser: The State Border Guard Service's Forpost Brigade has regained control of more than ten square kilometers of territory in its area of responsibility.

items.title: Brigade Forpost meldet Geländegewinne von 10 Quadratkilometern
items.teaser: Die Brigade Forpost des Staatlichen Grenzschutzdienstes hat in ihrem Einsatzbereich mehr als zehn Quadratkilometer zurückerobert.

items.title: Crime scene: The Black Sea. How the war is poisoning the water, killing wildlife and changing landscapes
Ukrainian border guards report regaining control of over 10 sq km of territory
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Forpost Border Guard Brigade says it has regained control of more than 10 sq km on the South Slobozhanshchyna front since taking over its sector in June.

items.title: 5 Russian missiles and drones exploded on Moldova's territory in overnight attack against Ukraine, Sandu says
items.teaser: "Moscow is putting lives at risk across Europe and must be stopped," Moldovan President Maia Sandu said on Oct. 3.

items.title: Five drones flew over Moldova, explosions reported in several districts
items.teaser: Moldova's national airspace monitoring system detected several drones flying over the country on Saturday morning.

items.title: Ukrainian woman detained in Kazakhstan after alleged FSB trap over grandson's return
items.teaser: Rozhanska attempted to collect her 8-year-old grandson and bring him back to his father in Odesa under an agreement reached in advance with the boy’s Russian relatives.

items.title: Streitkräfte treffen Startplatz für Drohnen in Region Donezk und Militärobjekte in Region Belgorod
items.teaser: Einheiten der ukrainischen Streitkräfte haben am 2. Oktober und in der Nacht zum 3. Oktober einen Startplatz für Drohnen der russischen Angreifer in der Region Donezk getroffen.

items.title: Five killed, dozens injured in Russian attacks in Kharkiv region over past day
items.teaser: Russian forces shelled Kharkiv and 13 settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past day, killing five people and injuring another 49.

items.title: Russian relays used to control Shahed drones operating in Kyiv – technology expert Flash
items.teaser: Presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov says Russian MESH radio relays may be operating in Kyiv, allowing Shahed drones to be controlled and their strikes adjusted in real time.

items.title: Fall Widdecombe: Möglicherweise auch Anschlag auf Farage geplant
items.teaser: Im Juli wurde ein 28-Jähriger im Fall der getöteten Brexit-Politikerin Widdecombe wegen Mordes angeklagt. Die Ermittler stellen nun eine Verbindung zu weiteren Anschlagspläne her - unter anderem gegen Rechtspopulist Farage.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike drone launch site in Donetsk region, military targets in Russia's Belgorod region
items.teaser: Units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck a site used to launch attack drones and a Russian crossing in the Donetsk region, as well as a command post and a warehouse in Russia's Belgorod region, on October 2 and early on October 3.

items.title: Russian strikes kill 8, injure 83 across Ukraine, target another key Kyiv bridge
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces intercepted 131 drones. Hits were recorded at 12 locations, while falling debris was reported at five other sites.

items.title: Russians attack Izium with drones: five injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a series of drone strikes on Izium, Kharkiv Oblast, on the morning of 3 October. Five people have been injured.

items.title: Russen verletzen in Region Donezk zehn Zivilisten
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer hätten am 2. Oktober zehn Menschen in der Region Donezk verletzt.

items.title: Russia strikes another major bridge in Kyiv, says mayor
items.teaser: The attack on Kyiv's Northern Bridge comes after the Southern Bridge on the Dnipro river was hit multiple times by Russia's drones.

items.title: Five injured as Russian forces attack Izium with drones
items.teaser: Five people were injured and premises of two enterprises and residential buildings were damaged in Izium, Kharkiv region, as a result of a Russian drone attack on Saturday morning.

items.title: Air defense intercepts 131 of 157 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 131 of the 157 drones used by Russian invaders to attack Ukraine from the evening of October 2.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports strike on UAV launch site and Russian crossing
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck a storage and launch site for attack drones, a Russian military command post and a crossing on 2 October and on the night of 2-3 October.

items.title: War update: 194 combat clashes on front lines over past day, Kostiantynivka, Pokrovsk axes hottest
items.teaser: As many as 194 combat engagements between Ukrainian forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front on Friday, October 2, with the fiercest fighting recorded on the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk axes.

items.title: „Koalition mit der Linken wäre der Sargnagel für die SPD“ – Leser warnen vor Bündnis in Berlin
items.teaser: Leser streiten über die Linke, den Verfassungsschutz und die Folgen möglicher Koalitionen in Berlin.

items.title: Luftabwehr macht 131 von 157 russischen Drohnen un schädlich
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 131 Drohnen neutralisiert, womit die russischen Besatzer seit Freitagabend, am 2. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hatten.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since evening, injuring four people
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times with drones and artillery, injuring four women.

items.title: Eklat um Verfassungsschutz: Weimer hält heikle Dokumente unter Verschluss
items.teaser: Kulturstaatsminister Wolfram Weimer hat zentrale Unterlagen, die zum Ausschluss dreier Läden vom Buchhandlungspreis führten, zur Verschlusssache erklärt – obwohl die Gründe dafür zweifelhaft erscheinen.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,538,950 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1, 560 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Casualties from Russian strike on Hostomel rise to four
items.teaser: In Hostomel, Kyiv region, four people, including a child, were injured as a result of a Russian attack.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 194 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon in Richtungen Pokrowsk und Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 2. Oktober kam es zu 194 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front. Die Mehrheit davon wurden Richtungen Pokrowsk und Kostjantyniwka gemeldet.

items.title: Number injured in Russian guided bomb attack on Kharkiv rises to 42
items.teaser: Two women were killed and 42 people, including three children, were injured in Russian guided bomb and drone attacks on Kharkiv on 2 October.

items.title: Russian attack damages road surface on Kyiv's Northern Bridge, blocking traffic to right bank
items.teaser: On the North Bridge in Kyiv, the road surface and the trolleybus overhead wire system were damaged as a result of a Russian attack; traffic to the right bank has been blocked.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 157 drones overnight, hits recorded at 12 locations
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 157 drones overnight, including 45 jet-powered Shaheds. Ukraine's air defence destroyed or jammed 131 drones, while hits were recorded at 12 locations.

items.title: Russian forces lose another 1,560 soldiers in war against Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, through October 3, 2026—amount to approximately 1,538,950 personnel, including 1,560 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Nordbrücke in Kyjiw durch russischen Angriff beschädigt, Verkehr zum rechten Ufer gesperrt
items.teaser: Auf der Nordbrücke über den Dnipro in Kyjiw wurden die Fahrbahnoberfläche und Oberleitungen von Trolleybussen wegen des russischen Angriffs beschädigt.

items.title: Battlefield sees 194 combat clashes over past day – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 194 combat clashes over the past day, including 21 Russian attacks on the Kostiantynivka front and 19 on the Pokrovsk front.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1560 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) liegen im Russland-Krieg gegen die Ukraine vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 3. Oktober 2026 bei rund 1.538.950 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 1900 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russian forces attack North Bridge in Kyiv
items.teaser: Russian troops struck the North Bridge in Kyiv early Saturday morning.

items.title: Eighteen people injured in Russian attacks across three oblasts
items.teaser: At least 18 people were injured in Russian attacks on Donetsk, Kherson and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts over the past day and on the night of 2-3 October.

items.title: Ukraine approves 1,530 new models of military equipment for service this year
items.teaser: Since the beginning of 2026, the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense has codified and approved for use by the Defense Forces 1,678 new models of weapons and military equipment, more than 1,500 of which were manufactured in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia strikes second Kyiv bridge during 3rd straight day of infrastructure attacks
items.teaser: Mayor Vitali Klitschko said that the bridge's surface as well as trolleybus overhead power lines have been damaged in the attack. Movement over the bridge was halted following the strike.

items.title: Russia loses 1,560 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,560 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian attack strikes fire station in Zaporizhzhia, injuring firefighter
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked a fire and rescue unit in the Zaporizhzhia region with a drone, injuring a rescuer.

items.title: Russian jet-powered drone strikes Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv
items.teaser: A Russian jet-powered drone struck Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge, according to local Telegram channels and Mayor Vitali Klitschko. No information about the extent of the damage or possible casualties has been reported.

items.title: Russian attack sparks fire at business center in downtown Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked Dnipro, causing a fire in a business center.

items.title: Bundeswehr schützt Luftraum während Wahlen in Lettland
